{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stone Age''' was a prehistoric [[Time/Legends|time]] period. The [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] creatures, native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], existed at a pre-Stone Age level of development. They lived in family groups and used simple tools. The same could be said for the [[Karran]] species when they were observed during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
